modifierHelper.title: Modifier helper

groups.woundmalus: Changes wound penalties or the number of wound levels.
groups.focusregeneration: Changes focus regeneration by a bonus or multiplier.
groups.healthregeneration: Changes health regeneration by a bonus or multiplier.
groups.focus: Changes the focus costs of spells and enhancements.

modifierHelper.pathDamageType: Damage type to which the resistance or weakness applies.
modifierHelper.fixedDamageFeatures: Note: This additional damage is a fixed number without dice of its own. Dice features such as Scharf, Exakt and Kritisch have no effect on it. The original weapon or spell dice remain unchanged.

adjustments.invalidCount: Enter a whole number from 1 up to the permitted maximum.
adjustments.unavailable: This modifier is not currently registered. Check the additional effect manually.
adjustments.single: An existing single effect allows only one modifier. Create the additional effect separately as another effect or in a comma-separated list input.
adjustments.sharpnessLimit: The current Scharf level must be a whole number from 0 to less than half the number of die faces (W6: below 3, W10: below 5).
adjustments.defensive: At most once. Requires the item to already have Defensiv.
adjustments.hardened: This increases the tick penalty by 1. Increase the value manually in the item properties. "tickmalus +1" is not an equivalent replacement.
adjustments.stable: This increases encumbrance by 1. Increase the value manually in the item properties. "handicap +1" is not an equivalent replacement.
adjustments.steadfast: This increases encumbrance or the tick penalty by 1. Increase the value manually in the item properties. "handicap +1" or "tickmalus +1" is not an equivalent replacement.
adjustments.padded: This increases encumbrance and the tick penalty by 1. Increase the values manually in the item properties. "handicap +1, tickmalus +1" is not an equivalent replacement.
adjustments.cold: Disable the handicap checkbox if the encumbrance is already included in the item properties.

modifierHelper.invalid: Check the required fields, value and attributes. This combination does not produce a valid modifier.
modifierHelper.noEffect: This value produces no change. Enter a value that has an effect.

errors.valueChoice: Select one of the offered values.
errors.featureLevel: Enter a positive whole number as the feature level.
errors.fumbleLevels: Enter a whole number of table steps.
errors.attributeSyntax: This text cannot be used as an attribute. Equals signs, line breaks, plain numbers and mixed quotation marks are not supported here.
errors.valueSyntax: Enter exactly one number, dice formula or reference, e.g. 2, 2W6+1 or ${attributes.strength.value}.
errors.costSyntax: Invalid focus costs. Example: K3V1 for a total of 3 channeled points, of which 1 is consumed. The consumed amount must not exceed the total.

modifierHelper.closedTarget: The original input is no longer editable. Open the helper there again.

attributes.skill: Applies only to this skill. Without a selection, there is no skill restriction.
attributes.castDurationSkill: Affects spells using the selected skill, normally a school of magic or Arcane Lore. Without a selection, there is no skill restriction.
attributes.magicFumbleSkill: Applies only to spells using the selected school of magic or Arcane Lore. Without a selection, there is no skill restriction.
attributes.focusSkill: Applies only to spells of the selected school of magic. Without a selection, the source item's skill is used if one is set; otherwise there is no skill restriction.
attributes.attribute1: Applies only to skills using this attribute, regardless of order. If both attribute filters are set, both must match.
attributes.attribute2: Applies only to skills using this attribute, regardless of order. If both attribute filters are set, both must match.
attributes.emphasis: Named specialization; the modifier is offered as a choice when making the check.
attributes.damageType: Damage type of the additional damage. Without a selection, the item's damage type applies.
attributes.defenseType: Restricts the change to the selected active defense.
attributes.item: Exact name of the affected item. Cannot be combined with a spell type.
attributes.itemType: Applies only to items of this type.
attributes.feature: For features with [Level], enter the level in the value field. For features without levels, selecting the feature is sufficient.
attributes.features: Apply only to this additional damage, not to the original weapon or spell dice. Example: Scharf 2 with a value of 1W6. Separate multiple features with commas. Scharf is capped at half the number of die faces (W6: 3, W10: 5). For features of the item itself, choose the improve feature or add feature variant.
attributes.spellType: Spell type, e.g. Schaden. Can only be combined with a school of magic or Arcane Lore and without an item-name filter.
attributes.checkType: Applies only to the selected check type. Without a selection, there is no restriction to attacks, spells, active defense or skill checks.
attributes.costType: Applies only to spells of this type, e.g. Schaden. Without an entry, there is no spell-type restriction.
attributes.category: Result category for which the degrees of success are changed.
attributes.rollType: Required roll strategy for the affected checks.
attributes.unit: Unit of the added value. Negative values reduce the casting duration.

descriptions.skills: Changes skill values, optionally filtered by attributes or skill.
descriptions.initiative: Changes initiative. Negative values improve it.
descriptions.healthpoints: Changes health points per health level.
descriptions.multiplier: Multiplies {target} by the value, e.g. 0.5 for half.
descriptions.resourceBonus: Additional buffer for exhausted and consumed points; does not apply to channeled points ({target}).
descriptions.splinterpoints: Changes the maximum number of splinterpoints.
descriptions.splinterpointBonus: Increases the check bonus granted when spending a splinterpoint. The highest matching bonus applies, including the default bonus.
descriptions.lowerfumbleresult: Lowers the result on the magic fumble table by the specified number of table steps. Applies to sorcerers and priests; combat fumbles are unchanged.
descriptions.bonuscap: Changes the cap on bonuses from equipment and magic.
descriptions.resistance: Increases resistance to the selected damage type.
descriptions.weakness: Increases weakness to the selected damage type.
descriptions.woundmalus_nbrlevels: Sets the number of health levels directly to 1, 3 or 5. Other positive values are not supported.
descriptions.woundmalus_mod: Negative values reduce wound penalties, down to a minimum of 0.
descriptions.woundmalus_levelmod: Shifts the calculated wound level without changing health points. +1 means one level more severely wounded.
descriptions.initiativewoundmalus: Currently has no effect on initiative when entered as a modifier; the internal initiative wound penalty still works. Use initiative for general initiative changes.
descriptions.focusregeneration_bonus: Adds points to focus regeneration during rest.
descriptions.healthregeneration_bonus: Adds points to health regeneration during rest.
descriptions.tickmalusArmor: Changes the tick penalty from armor.
descriptions.tickmalusShield: Changes the tick penalty from shields.
descriptions.itemDamage: Adds a separate damage component to matching weapons, attacks or spells. Its features do not change the original damage.
descriptions.weaponSpeed: Changes weapon speed. Negative values reduce it.
descriptions.defenseTickCost: Changes the tick cost of active defense.
descriptions.mergeFeature: Compares the feature level to the existing feature and uses the higher level.
descriptions.addFeature: Adds a feature level to an existing or new feature.
descriptions.castDuration: Changes the casting duration by the value in ticks or minutes.
descriptions.castDurationMultiplier: Multiplies the casting duration by the value.
descriptions.checkResult: Changes the degrees of success for the selected result category.
descriptions.checkRequire: Requires a roll strategy, such as a safety roll or risk roll, for matching checks.
descriptions.focusReduction: Reduces the normal focus costs of a spell.
descriptions.focusAddition: Increases the normal focus costs of a spell.
descriptions.enhancedReduction: Reduces the additional focus costs of enhancing a spell.
descriptions.enhancedAddition: Increases the additional focus costs of enhancing a spell.

dialog.title: Splittermond: Data Migration
dialog.content:
This migration runs all pending data migrations for items — both for all world items and all items in third-party compendia.

Important: Please ensure all compendia to be migrated are set to writable (unlocked). Locked compendia will be skipped and listed after completion.

System compendia (shipped with the Splittermond system) are not affected by this migration.

The migration is idempotent — it can be re-run without risk.

itemMigration.result: Migration complete: {worldItems} world items, {packs} compendia migrated, {skipped} compendia skipped (read-only).

dialog.title: Splittermond: Modifier Migration
dialog.content:
This migration transports each item's system.modifier string into persistent Active Effects of type modifier — one effect per modifier fragment. The system.modifier field is cleared afterwards, so the modifiers survive as durable effects instead of being rebuilt on every update.

Important: Please ensure all compendia to be migrated are set to writable (unlocked). Locked compendia will be skipped and listed after completion.

System compendia (shipped with the Splittermond system) are not affected by this migration.

The migration is idempotent — it can be re-run without risk.
